story: Explore the fascinating world of the Amur Paradise Fly Catcher (Terpsiphone incei). Classified under the Monarchidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Broadleaf lowland and hill forests; also more open habitats during migration and winter. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Amur Paradise Fly Catcher is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Amur Paradise Fly Catcher, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
